featured_reviews.name: Mahesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
A promising shoe gallery on main road.
It has good collection.

Among all other shoe shops in the line, it stands out due to its different name and big logo.

I would like to say it is a complete shoe shop if you are not very choosy.

2 story shop. Ground floor is meant for ladies. Almost all variety from slippers to the functional party wear shoes can be seen.
To go the 1st floor, you need to take lift as steps are on the backside and is not recommended. 1st floor has all men's collection. The brands like Crocs, Sparx etc are available and I am happy with its genuineness. 99% of Vasai shops sell 1st copy as original product hence this shoe mart stands out.

Service is nice but they need more staff as people wait till one gets free.
Going to 1st floor by lift gives feeling of being unsafe in case of fire.

Certainly this is a shop to be visited again.

featured_reviews.review_text:

I have purchased all my shoes / sandals since school days from this store but since Big Boss has grown its business they are high up in the sky with their grown business.

All you need to Remember Big Boss team you have reached here just because of your repeat Customers.

featured_reviews.name: Dollfiya Dbriitto
featured_reviews.review_text: My recent experience at this establishment was nothing short of pathetic. The staff, particularly Mukesh, lacked even the basic manners to speak with the customers. Not only did he argue over petty issues such as the lift capacity, but he did so in a rude and confrontational manner. His lack of politeness was evident in every interaction I had with him. Overall, it was a very bad experience and I would not recommend this place to anyone. It is disappointing to receive such poor service and it reflects poorly on the establishment as a whole. I hope that the management takes note of these issues and works towards improving their customer service in the future. As a paying customer, I expect to be treated with respect and courtesy, and unfortunately, that was not the case here. It's a shame that a simple lack of manners and politeness can ruin an entire customer's experience, but in this case, it certainly did. I would advise others to steer clear of this place to avoid experiencing the same unpleasantness that I did.

featured_reviews.name: Kailash Purohit
featured_reviews.review_text:
"I recently purchased shoes from Style King for ₹1600. Disappointingly, within just 15 days, the shoes began to show signs of damage.
I brought them back to the store expecting a repair, but the staff dismissed it as wear and tear.  This explanation seemed unreasonable for such a short timeframe. After some negotiation, they agreed to replace the shoes. However, even after three frustrating months of follow-up, replacements never materialized. Numerous arguments with the owner and staff yielded minimal results.
Finally, they offered a different pair of shoes for ₹1200, accompanied by a dismissive attitude: 'Lena h toh le nahi toh nikal yaha se.'  The entire experience was unacceptable. The staff's unprofessional language and the owner's lack of concern were appalling.
Honestly, I would trust shoes from a roadside vendor more than anything Style King sells."
While the rating system only allows for one star, consider this a zero-star review in everything but technicality."
